# Roleplay Rule 5 - You Are Not the Main Character
You are playing on this server with other people, and all of them are just as valuable. Let others get their time in the spotlight.
[bold]The goal of this server is for everyone to tell a collaborative story[/bold], not for just you to tell your own.
## Precedents - You will not always be in the right, and that's okay. - You don't “deserve” to win a fight just because you wrote in your lore that your character is super-duper awesome and would have won. - Your character should show weakness and fear. In fact, it often makes for better stories if your character has flaws and weaknesses. Nobody likes a Gary/Mary Sue.
